'''Heartstriker''' was the name given by [[Jariah Syn]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[amphistaff]] he tamed on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] in [[137 ABY]].

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] was covered with [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[biot]]echnology.<ref name="Legacy 44" /> Efforts by the Yuuzhan Vong to [[Ossus Project|restore]] the devastated world's ecosystems eleven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[126 ABY|prior]]<ref name="Legacy 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref> had been sabotaged by agents of the [[One Sith]], and as a result, [[Plant/Legends|flora]] and fauna infected with the [[Vongspawn virus]] [[Mutant|mutated]] into violent and hostile creatures. Included in their number were [[amphistaff]]s<ref name="Legacy 44" />&mdash;[[Snake|serpentine]] beings often employed by Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] as [[Quarterstaff/Legends|quarterstaffs]]<ref name="NJO Sourcebook">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref>&mdash;and in 137 ABY, one such creature discovered the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Fionah Ti]] inside of a [[damutek]] structure. As it reared to attack them, Syn began to speak to it in the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong]]. He had been taught the ways of the warrior caste by a Yuuzhan Vong [[Chonyo|warrior]] in his youth and was accordingly able to calm the amphistaff down. Syn named the creature "Heartstriker" and implored it to submit to his will. Heartstriker immediately acquiesced and coiled around its new master's waist.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

Syn would later use Heartstriker to kill [[Zenoc Quah]]. After leaving Wayland, Heartstriker remained attached to Syn's arm. He would bring it to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where [[Cade Skywalker]] was meeting with [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]]. It would accompany him to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] as well, where it was used to foil an [[Unidentified assassin (Gar Stazi)|assassination]] attempt on [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].
